creator: Daqing Chen
citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
selection: Top 20 by positive non-cancelled training-period units; five-digit product codes with optional letter suffix
transforms: Date reduced to calendar day; cancellations and negative quantities retained for quality checks; no line IDs invented; no sales generated
coverage_assumption: Full published transaction extract treated as complete calendar-day coverage, including zero-sale days; not independently verified store opening records
